environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with ALL rules in BLOCK mode and sensitivity level set to HIGH, and (3) a custom rate-limiting rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The ALB target group health check hits /health. The WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB ARN and processes all requests before they reach the target group. CloudWatch metrics confirm WAF is evaluating requests (non-zero EvaluatedRequests metric). SQLite database is on ephemeral Fargate storage at /var/lib/app/users.db.

config.load_balancer: ALB with WAF v2 WebACL association
